name: CodeGraph for Claude Code
description: Runs `codegraph install --yes --target claude --location global`: registers the codegraph MCP server, its `codegraph prompt-hook` UserPromptSubmit hook and the `mcp__codegraph__*` auto-allow permission, unless ~/.claude.json already has a user-scope codegraph MCP server (gentle-ai does not set codegraph up for Claude Code). Needs jq.
